relations: 伴侣/身份：Ares 与 Kayla——Ares 是酒吧老板，Kayla 向他求一份他店里的工作；本章两人确认恋人关系。原文："I would like a job at your bar." / "Yes, boyfriend, because even though I'm not sure how to feel anything, I know I want you." / "the four of you are more than enough for me"（数字 four 指四个男人）
上下级/占有式关系：Clay 对 Kayla 设限并以暴力威胁替她出头。原文："No, you are free to do whatever you want, as long as it doesn't involve other men." / "Fine, but if they touch you, I will break their hands."

伴侣（同居者）：Brawley 与 Vero——Brawley 在 Vero 失控时按住他安抚，Vero 随后安静点头；Vero 想让 Kayla 睡进"mine and Brawley's bed"。原文："I look at Brawley, and he reaches over and puts his hand on Vero's knee, then leans in and whispers in his ear." / "I want her in mine and Brawley's bed"
朋友/赠礼关系：Clay 赠 Vero 华夫饼机。原文："Clay got him a waffle machine for Christmas, but he used it once and is now banned from touching it again after nearly burning the kitchen down."（Christmas、once）

敌对/前任：Aaron 与 Kayla——Aaron 是她恐惧的来源与前任，Clay 与 Brawley 曾把他从地里挖出来。原文："I know everything with Aaron wasn't something you signed up for." / "Just knowing it was him in my safe space has freaked me out a little." / "he manipulated me in ways that I hadn't realized until I left"

facts.fact: Kayla 在早餐桌上向四个男人表明心意，说她想要现在这段关系、愿意全心投入，只要对方还愿意接受她。
facts.anchor: Whatever this is, or what we are, I want it. I’m all in if that is still something that’s on offer.

facts.fact: Vero 误解她的话，安静地问她是不是要走，并威胁说如果她要走自己会把她绑走。
facts.anchor: Because if you’re saying you’re leaving, I need you to know I will kidnap you.

facts.fact: Kayla 承认自己害怕回到公寓，因为知道进过她安全空间的是 Aaron；她说这不是她一向的样子。
facts.anchor: What I am trying to say, and it’s hard for me, is that I’m afraid to go back to my apartment.

facts.fact: Kayla 向 Ares 提出要在他的酒吧工作。
facts.anchor: I would like a job at your bar.

facts.fact: Clay 说破他们本来就打算不让 Kayla 离开她的视线，并承认他曾设想过一场大吵加上 hate sex。
facts.anchor: Did you really think we were going to let you out of our sight after what happened?

facts.fact: Clay 设下条件：她可以自由，但不得牵涉别的男人；Kayla 当场拒绝让他替她做决定。
facts.anchor: No, you are free to do whatever you want, as long as it doesn’t involve other men.

facts.fact: Ares 定下住处规矩：Kayla 拥有自己的房间，睡谁的床由她自己选。
facts.anchor: Kayla will have her own room, and if she chooses to sleep in any of our beds, that’s up to her.

facts.fact: Ares 认领 boyfriend 身份（说即使自己不确定会不会有感觉也确定想要她），两人在淋浴间发生关系。
facts.anchor: Yes, boyfriend, because even though I’m not sure how to feel anything, I know I want you.
